items.question: How many specialised sub-committees does the UAE's National Anti-Money Laundering and Combating Financing of Terrorism and Financing of Illegal Organisations Committee operate through?
items.fact: NAMLCFTC operates through eight specialised sub-committees

items.question: In UAE money laundering law, must the illicit source of the proceeds be proven before the predicate offence perpetrator can be sentenced?
items.gold: No, proving the illicit source should not be a prerequisite to sentencing the predicate offence perpetrator.
items.fact: Proving illicit source is not prerequisite to sentencing predicate offender
